verdict.rationale: CrewAI lets you build agents that produce AI-generated analysis from your own data. Its tools are documented to cover data analysis, users can pass their own files via knowledge_source for vector-indexed context, and Crew Studio offers a no-code way to assemble such crews. However, there is no out-of-the-box feature that surfaces insights or suggestions from your data inside the product; you must design and run the crew yourself. Missing for 10: a built-in insight/suggestion feature over user data, first-party docs describing an insights experience, and independent hands-on corroboration of data-insight use cases.
